summary_paragraph: A woman with type 1 diabetes, gastroparesis, and anxiety was admitted for nausea and vomiting. She developed transient hyponatremia and mild diabetic ketoacidosis after discontinuing her insulin pump due to hypoglycemia. She was managed with IV fluids, insulin, and antiemetics. Her white blood cell count was initially elevated but downtrended without evidence of infection. Her diet was advanced as nausea resolved, and she was restarted on her insulin pump. By discharge, she was tolerating a regular diet, hemodynamically stable, and cleared to return home with medication adjustments and follow-up plans.
problems: Diabetes with ketoacidosis, type I [juvenile type], uncontrolled
